about: Tambov airfield is 10 km north-east of the centre of Tambov, near the village of Donskoye. Operator: TOGBU Tambov Airport. The airport has federal status, one runway 2,098 × 42 m.

terminals.title: Terminal
terminals.text: Security screening is at the terminal entrance. The departure hall is on Level 1, with the check-in counters. There are no scanners for electronic boarding passes: print yours in advance or get it at the counter.

kids.title: With children
kids.text: Room for passengers with children under 7: bedroom, bed, toilet. Free, during airport opening hours. Passport, ticket and medical certificate required. The certificate is issued free at the first-aid post, Level 1 of the administrative building. Apply to the passenger handling service.

parking.title: Parking
parking.text: Free parking on the station forecourt. There are spaces for people with disabilities. The airport is not responsible for cars left there.
